zxMusic.title: Hybrid Engine (title) 1
zxMusic.description:
This is a the composition DoomBass, with different (softer) drums. The file contains also a few extra short tunes.It was intended to be a soundtrack for the game WWI Fighting Heroes, but there was a problem with dislocated sprites in the game after adding the music. The issue was caused by an error in returning from the music player to the game (stack). So, finally only the title song was published in the game.
It was also published at the Battle of the Bits, in a compo (experimental or progressive music) as a single mp3 mix.
